name: APKScanner focused Deep Link to JSBridge state-change fixture

vulnerabilities.title: Attacker-controlled Deep Link page changes native state through StateBridge
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary app can send bridgefocus://web?url=<attacker page> to the exported BridgeActivity; the target WebView loads that page and exposes StateBridge.setEnabled(boolean), whose void call persistently changes target-owned configuration and its native state TextView from state:off to state:on.
